issue.title: Document Pomodoro entry-line move/rename in the Pomodoro glossary strand
issue.description: bob-navigation-hotkeys 1.29.0 (shipped per plans/202608/pomodoro_entry_move.md) added a third Ctrl+Shift+M route: placing the cursor on the Pomodoro entry line itself. The sase/memory/glossary/pomodoro.md strand currently documents only the sub-bullet form ("On a sub-bullet, N<ctrl+shift+m> moves it and the next N siblings into another open Pomodoro, or into a new named one below.") and needs a sentence describing the new entry-line behavior.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Add a sentence alongside the existing sub-bullet description: on a Pomodoro entry line itself, Ctrl+Shift+M opens the same destination picker; choosing another open Pomodoro moves every sub-bullet the entry owns there and deletes the entry (or just deletes it if it owns nothing movable), while typing a name that is not an existing open Pomodoro's name renames the entry in place instead of moving or creating anything. Any count typed before the keymap is accepted but ignored on an entry line, since the operation is whole-entry.
